label: A zero-lot-line lot in southwest Edmonton

source.document: Preliminary plot plan prepared by an Alberta land surveyor
source.note: Preliminary, for siting purposes only. Parcel identifiers and civic address removed for publication.

cantilever.note: Second floor projects over the inset garage wall on the zero-lot-line side. Above roughly 3 m the massing is the full lot-width rectangle.

orientation.datum_note: Bearing read from the plan's north symbol. Alberta subdivision plans are referenced to 3TM grid north; grid convergence at this longitude is about 0.3°, which is below the resolution of the drawing.
